title: Static Docs Public/Private Compliance Audit v1

findings.current: No public/private classification exists on source governance artifacts. Site manifest has no classification field. Safety scan runs before publish but does not check classification.
findings.required: Add public_private_classification field to site manifest document entries. Classify each of 233 documents. Safety scan must reject internal_only documents from publication.

findings.current: Internal governance JSON files (procurement evidence packs, enterprise data inventory, identity auth model) are listed in site manifest with no classification check. If any of these contain internal-only content, they would be published.
findings.required: Audit 71 governance documents for internal-only content. Mark as internal_only if they contain procurement-specific, enterprise-specific, or pre-release content. Safety scan already catches tokens/secrets but not procurement-sensitive metadata.

findings.current: Search index is regenerated from document summaries. If an internal_only document is accidentally indexed, its summary would appear in search-index.json. Safety scan runs on rendered HTML but not on search index content.
findings.required: Add classification-aware filtering to search index generation. Exclude internal_only documents from search index.

findings.current: Safety scan (rig_relay/docs_renderer/safety.py) runs before publish and detects token/secret leaks. 264 pages scanned, zero leaks found.
findings.required: None — safety scan is working correctly. Must ensure it also checks for absolute paths and source snippets.

findings.current: Site manifest has disclosure policy (reviewer, contributor, maintainer) but this controls progressive disclosure in the UI, not publication access control.
findings.required: Add publication_classification field distinct from disclosure_policy. Publication classification governs whether a document appears in the public site at all.

current_protections: Safety scan (token/secret detection) runs before every publish — catches leaks
Content-light doctrine enforced across all governance JSON artifacts
Substrate doctrine page explicitly declares SQLite forbidden, Parquet derived-not-canonical, etc.
Cross-surface evidence schema spine defines common envelope fields — prevents field leakage
recommended_additions: public_private_classification enum on all site manifest documents: public_safe, internal_only, procurement_only, review_draft
Publication filter in static docs renderer: skip internal_only, procurement_only, and review_draft documents
Search index filter: exclude internal_only documents from search-index.json
Classification audit of 71 governance documents — identify any that should be internal_only
Classification check in safety scan: warn on publication of unclassified documents
